reference_answer: Light and Nimble, which greatly reduces the stamina cost of performing all charged heavy cudgel attacks.

db_evidence.notes: semantic_triples has no rows mentioning 身轻体快 or 身本忧 — this UI-menu fact is not present in the structured memory DB at all; every rollout correctly localized the time window (76680-76710s, converging near 76709.5s where the confirmation glow appears) via semantic_search/run_sql over episodes/entities, but the actual answer content can only come from clip_qa reading on-screen Chinese text. All 5 rollouts retrieved the same correct time window and called clip_qa there, so time-window retrieval was never the bottleneck — the divergence is entirely in the visual sub-agent's OCR/transcription accuracy at that one moment.

root_causes: This is a pure UI-text-reading (OCR) task with no supporting structured DB record; correctness depends entirely on the clip_qa visual sub-agent accurately transcribing small, partially glow-obscured Chinese menu text at a single confirmation frame (~76709.5s).
Rollout 1's visual sub-agent paraphrased the effect description instead of transcribing it verbatim, dropping the key qualifier '所有蓄力重棍' (charged heavy cudgel attacks), costing 1 judge point.

Rollout 4's visual sub-agent hallucinated/misread an entirely different, unrelated effect description ('reduces stamina when dodging') that does not appear on screen, causing a full score of 0 despite correctly naming the selected item.
what_worked: All 5 rollouts' retrieval agents converged on the same correct clue window (76680-76710s) via semantic_search + run_sql despite the fact not being present in any structured table, showing the timeline localization worked reliably.

3 of 5 rollouts' clip_qa calls verbatim-transcribed the small on-screen Chinese description text correctly, including the exact qualifier 'charged heavy cudgel attacks', matching the reference answer word-for-word in meaning.
transferable_lessons: For UI-menu/on-screen-text questions with no DB backing, the entire task reduces to visual sub-agent OCR accuracy; sample the exact confirmation frame (post-glow, ~76709.5s here) and request verbatim transcription rather than paraphrase.

When asking clip_qa to read on-screen effect descriptions, explicitly instruct it to quote the Chinese text verbatim (not summarize/paraphrase) to avoid dropping specific qualifiers that the judge weights heavily.

A visual misread that substitutes an entirely different but plausible-sounding effect (e.g. dodging vs. charged attacks) is scored as a hard failure (0), much worse than a same-topic under-specified paraphrase (scored 4) — sampling multiple nearby frames and cross-checking the description text against a zoomed crop (as rollouts 0/2/3 did) reduces this risk.
open_questions: Why rollout 4's clip_qa produced a description ('闪身'/dodging) that does not appear anywhere near this menu screen — whether it confused this item with a different 根器 upgrade seen elsewhere in the video, or purely hallucinated, was not traced further.
